reviewer_role: Independent read-only review; authored frozen Go fixtures, did not implement the reviewed Rust code
scope: CommandDiagnostics start/finish record semantics for a fresh per-command session
Direct CommandError::Joined traversal for Usage, Startup and Pipeline and source-wrapped diagnostic io::Error EPIPE
Context and CallerContext diagnostic scope decoration preserving parent error/deadline/cancelled/value/extension ports
Quiet config and non-debug session exclusions
Seven targeted Rust session tests and their bounded use of frozen Go expectations

findings.finding: Top-level-only Pipeline and Startup classification lost Go errors.As behavior when a diagnostic writer error created Joined; Pipeline then appended an unwanted envelope/error line
findings.evidence: startup_message and is_pipeline recursively inspect Joined; finish_command now applies NDJSON EPIPE, Startup, Usage, Pipeline, then ordinary error handling. The sealed six-row Go supplement captures exact exit/final stderr/started-failed attempts. Genuine Rust Pipeline RED preceded the correction

findings.finding: The original context test compared absent deadline/error values and did not exercise extension/cancellation forwarding
findings.evidence: Added scoped_context_delegates_deadline_extensions_and_cancel_future uses a real future deadline, extension(TypeId), parent cancellation, and a bounded await of the decorated cancelled future; source delegation preserves parent ports. Pending-future scheduling races are not claimed

confirmed_semantics: Started records retain selected Pixiv/FANBOX module and CLI request number zero
Finish chooses completed/failed from business plus cleanup before joining any diagnostic sink error
Diagnostic writer failure does not cancel business execution and the first EPIPE stays discoverable through DiagnosticWriteError::source after a different later writer failure
NDJSON EPIPE suppression precedes Startup, Usage and Pipeline classification and can suppress other joined business errors, matching the captured Go behavior
Joined ordinary Usage emits only its business message with exit 2; joined Startup emits only its bare business cause with exit 1; joined Pipeline adds no ordinary business error line and exits 1
Context scope decoration replaces the diagnostic sink without replacing parent value/deadline/error/cancelled/extension behavior

coverage_precision.rust_use_of_primary19: Root started/finish diagnostic record-byte projection only; feeds a synthetic business result inferred from each sealed expected finish record. It does not replay all 19 root business, writer, state, or exit observations
coverage_precision.rust_use_of_supplemental6: Fixed-clock session+finish_command classification, exact final error stderr and first two diagnostic payloads. No actual startup/download business run

verification.reviewer_go_capture_replays: Primary19/prior4 unchanged; supplemental6 fixed-clock capture passed; two count=3 combined replay/gofmt/vet gate runs passed

limits: Main/startup/update wiring and actual CLI subprocess integration are outside this review; they are being reviewed separately

CommandDiagnostics::start has no EnsureConfig argument. Actual root callers must gate it with the frozen lifecycle requirement; FANBOX auth list must remain silent at debug because Go EnsureConfig=false
The cleanup test feeds an already-joined cleanup result. It does not itself prove the main executor closes resources before calling finish
Linux/amd64 Go evidence and targeted Rust session execution only. No native Windows/Darwin compilation or runtime, ABI, registration, HKCU, browser, account, network, or media approval is implied
Raw errno 32 EPIPE assertions are Unix/Linux witnesses; they do not establish Windows native error-number semantics
No all-root parity, all 19 complete Rust root observations, full workspace gates, generic arbitrary boxed error-tree equivalence, or language-wide compatibility claim is approved
The approval covers only the listed byte snapshots and direct Session/core boundary. Later source changes require a scoped re-review
